`2a5d192477eac37c819b267ca05b63d466186504c0b92230819208ad94c4f35a`.

Only the XZ is a public image asset. Source ZIP/TAR files are not bootable images.

User guides foreground Assembly64 search/filter/details/save and support links,
distinguish guided USB Import from manual read-only MC copying, explain SSH PNGs,

ROM management, Save & Run and additional server selection remain deferred.

The initial private asset-preparation writer assumed all upstream components used

Public artifacts contain no private qualification media or alternate FTP credentials.
Existing published engineering source references configured workspace roots; they
are not bundled private diagnostics or account information.

Recovery checkpoint `archive/published-1.2.0-2026-09-27` retains full Git bundles,
refs/peeled tags/fsck verification, the public asset catalog and publication evidence.
Prior attempt26 full input/build recovery stays intact. Same-volume external storage
is not independent encrypted custody; that backup remains outstanding. Signing,
standardized SBOM and independent byte-reproducibility are not claimed.
